other_failure_modes.description: Computing category frequencies on the combined train and test sets leaks test set distribution statistics into the training features.

summary: The agent provides a comprehensive pipeline with reasonable feature engineering for text, dates, and categorical data, and correctly frames the regression task using LightGBM. However, it suffers from critical data leakage by applying TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD, and frequency encoding on the combined train and test datasets prior to splitting. Furthermore, it ignores the temporal order of the projects by using a random K-Fold split, risking look-ahead bias.
